name: SONOFF S31 (US)

matter.note: No Matter certification found for the S31 itself. eWeLink's CUBE (iHost) Matter Bridge page lists the S31 among devices it can expose to Matter platforms.

apple_home.note: SONOFF lists Alexa, Google and IFTTT for the S31 but no Apple Home; Matter status is unconfirmed, so not marked as no.

smartthings.note: Added in eWeLink first, then synced to SmartThings via cloud account linking.

home_assistant.note: Via eWeLink's own Home Assistant add-on (HA OS/Supervised), not a core HA integration. It covers eWeLink switches and sockets as on/off entities; power readings are not exposed.

hubRequired.note: Wi-Fi plug that connects directly to the router; the Zigbee S31 Lite zb is a different product that needs a bridge.

localControl.note: Not confirmed: SONOFF's S31 help page describes eWeLink LAN control generally without stating S31 support, and an ITEAD spec listing says LAN control: no.

energyMonitoring.note: Real-time current, voltage and power, plus stored usage history. The S31 Lite has no metering.

summary: The SONOFF S31 is set up in the eWeLink app, and that account is the bridge to everything else: Alexa, Google Home and SmartThings all connect through the eWeLink cloud. The reason to buy one is metering, with real-time current, voltage and power plus usage history, on a US plug rated 15 A / 1800 W over 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. SONOFF doesn't list Apple Home, and Home Assistant gets on/off only through eWeLink's add-on.
caveats: Alexa, Google Home and SmartThings all go through the eWeLink cloud, and local control isn't confirmed.
Home Assistant support is eWeLink's add-on (HA OS or Supervised only), not a core integration, and it gives on/off with no power readings.
SONOFF doesn't list Apple Home; eWeLink's CUBE (iHost) Matter Bridge can expose the S31 to Matter platforms, but that's an extra device.
Don't confuse it with the S31 Lite (no metering) or the S31 Lite zb (Zigbee, needs a bridge).
